children: Eikon Therapeutics reported updated TeLuRide-005 results showing a 63.1% response rate and 89.2% disease control rate with EIK1001 plus standard-of-care treatment.
Across 65 efficacy-evaluable participants, the combination achieved a 63.1% objective response rate and 89.2% disease control rate.
The squamous cohort had a 72.4% response rate, 100% disease control rate and 12.9-month median duration of response.
Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events occurred in 48.6%; 6.9% discontinued treatment due to these events.
Low-grade cytokine release syndrome was reported, with no Grade 3 or higher cases or treatment-related deaths; the profile supported outpatient administration.
The ongoing Phase 2/3 TeLuRide-008 trial expects a first interim dose-selection analysis in the second half of 2027.
